theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by
  have h_subset_or_compl : ∀ (A : Set S), A ∈ P ∨ Aᶜ ∈ P := by
    intro A
    by_cases hA : A ∈ P
    · exact Or.inl hA
    · right
      by_contra h
      exact hPS ⟨Aᶜ, h, fun U hU => hPP U hU Aᶜ h⟩
  
  have h_not_both : ∀ (A : Set S), A ∈ P → Aᶜ ∉ P := by
    intro A hA hAc
    have : A ∩ Aᶜ = ∅ := by ext x; simp
    exact (hPP A hA Aᶜ hAc) this.symm
  
  classical
  
  let Q : Finset (Set S) := (Finset.univ : Finset (Set S)) \ P
  
  have h₁ : P.card = Q.card := by
    have h₂ : ∀ A ∈ P, Aᶜ ∈ Q := by
      intro A hA
      simp only [Q, Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
      by_contra h
      have := h_subset_or_compl Aᶜ
      cases this with
      | inl hAc => exact h_not_both A hA hAc
      | inr hAcc => simp at hAcc; contradiction
    have h₃ : ∀ A ∈ Q, Aᶜ ∈ P := by
      intro A hA
      by_contra h
      have := h_subset_or_compl A
      cases this with
      | inl hA' => simp_all
      | inr hAc => simp_all
    apply Finset.card_bij' (fun A _ => Aᶜ) (fun A _ => Aᶜ)
    · exact h₂
    · exact h₃
    · intro a ha; simp
    · intro a ha; simp
  
  have h₂ : P.card + Q.card = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
    have : P.card + Q.card = (Finset.univ : Finset (Set S)).card := by
      rw [← Finset.card_sdiff (Finset.sdiff_subset_of_subset (by simp)), Q]
      simp
    rw [this, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_set]
  
  have h₃ : Fintype.card S ≥ 1 := by
    have : 0 < Fintype.card S := by positivity
    omega
  
  have h₄ : 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) * 2 = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
    rw [← pow_succ, Nat.sub_add_cancel h₃]
  
  omega
